# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Role:** mail carrier (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Nell-girl P24](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0024)</sub>  
  _previously: farmer (v2)_  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P8](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0008), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P20](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P55](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0055), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P70](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0070), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P39](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

Pettifer is a heavy-set, short man who lacks hair and is not considered good-looking. He possesses a circular countenance and bulging azure eyes, and he is sometimes seen smoking a pipe.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

## Personality

Pettifer is an exceptionally candid and occasionally impetuous man who is noted for being exacting and critical, often proving difficult to satisfy. Although generally pleasant—a trait that doubled after his remarriage—he resents being the object of pity and holds a bias against matrimony. At times, his belief that he is predestined for everlasting damnation causes him to snap at others out of cussedness.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P78](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0078), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), [v3 ch.Atonement” P39](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0039), +2 more_

## History

Mr. Pettifer initially confronted [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after her cow escaped into his oat field, but when she accidentally sold his Jersey cow soon after, he generously accepted her cow in trade and hosted her for tea. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later sought donations from him for [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) projects, though he turned down her request, and the two frequently debated local town matters and community figures. When young [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) went missing, she was discovered locked inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md). Later, a severe hail storm struck his home with lightning and killed his pet parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit and offer him comfort. During his grief, he opened up to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about his past marriage, his prior quarrel over the bird, and his eventual reconciliation with his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md). As [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) pursued literary ambitions, Mr. Pettifer critiqued her manuscripts and encouraged her to continue writing about subjects familiar to her after she faced early magazine rejections. During a snowy [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday, he delivered mail to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) containing news that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) had been left a one-thousand-dollar bequest.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), +34 more_

## Background by volume

**Volume 2**

- lifelong bachelor  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P77](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0077)</sub>
- received his parrot Nutmeg from his brother, a sailor  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)</sub>
- relocated from Scottsford, New Brunswick to Brierley  <sub>[v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- was routine whipped by his schoolmaster as a boy  <sub>[v2 IV Different Opinions P36](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0036)</sub>

**Volume 3**

- delayed marriage for too long  <sub>[v3 ch.Atonement” P76](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> "Apologies, young lady! Expressing regret will not fix what happened. You ought to walk over and view the destruction that creature caused among my oats . . . crushed them completely from the middle to the edges, young lady."
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> "He . . . he utters foolishness constantly. My brother, a seafaring man, gave him to me. A sailor's speech isn't always particularly refined, and birds like parrots copy things easily."
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)

> “Who? Mrs. Sowerby? Do not tell me that I resemble that ancient chatterbox,” Mr. Pettifer said in an annoyed manner. “I am not . . . not in the least. What is inside that box?”
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P27](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0027)

> "I do not, indeed, and I am extremely pleased with it, as well. You have my gratitude. The surface appears nice. My expectation is that it remains just as nice underneath."
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Listen to my suggestion, young lady, you need to assist me in consuming it. After I set the kettle to boil, a cup of tea will be enjoyed by both of us. Is that acceptable to you?"
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

### [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-henry-carter--pettifer.md)

Pettifer employs [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) as a hired helper and worker. Following a severe storm that struck Pettifer's house and killed his pet parrot, Carter carried the news to neighboring residents.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), +2 more_

- Commands — employed as a hired helper or worker  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--pettifer.md)

Pettifer and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are neighbors who frequently share visits and conversations regarding community news, classroom discipline, and local gossip. Though their relationship faced early strain when Pettifer confronted her over a wandering cow and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally sold his Jersey cow by mistake, he accepted her apology, traded cows generously, and invited her for tea. Their friendly neighborly bond persists through routine debates and visits, including [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stopping by to comfort him after a storm killed his parrot.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), +23 more_

- Friend of — neighbors who share visits and conversations  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)</sub>

### [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/pettifer--robin-farrow.md)

[Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) admires Pettifer and acts as his friend, assisting him with hauling dulse. However, their connection experiences occasional trouble, such as when [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) played a trick by locking young [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) inside Pettifer's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), +2 more_

- Friend of — assisting him with hauling dulse and admiring him  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)</sub>
